turns.question: What is our net revenue for the fiscal year to date, as of the end of 6 October 2026?
turns.answer: Net revenue (revenue minus partner returns, finance's net sales) for the fiscal year to date, 1 February 2026 (fiscal 2026 start) through 6 October 2026, is EUR 19,521.84. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
